//: The local agent's own settings. Its allowlist is the last word on this host: a command the platform signed is still refused if the action isn't listed here, or its parameters fall outside these bounds. sample.file_info is a custom action of the sample agent build (samples/Juice.Observability.Agent.Sample, installed by e2e/agent-custom.mjs); an agent without it never offers it. Its Values name the only files it may look at. service.restart and files.cleanup are here to try in the Console: the agent's container has no systemd, so a restart fails with 'systemctl not found', and the cleanup only touches /tmp/juice-demo-*.log files older than a day.
